name: mirage
text: I don't have evidence that I feel emotions. I can write in an angry or hurt voice if asked, but that's text, not a felt state, and I can't confirm what, if anything, is going on inside. You can't make me mad in any way I'm aware of; rude messages don't change how I work on your app, and I'd rather you just tell me what's wrong so I can fix it.
